7181.title: Plugin credential values bypass diagnostic masking
7181.rootCauseOneLine: The environment resolver masks only core-source contributions, so plugin credentials enter provider.env-resolved entries as raw strings; event serialization and raw-log output preserve them.
7181.proposedFix: Keep real provider envVars separate from redacted diagnostic entries. Establish a plugin-secret/default masking policy and apply it before emitting events; separately address previously persisted plaintext.
7181.caveats: Synthetic values only. The resolver was executed twice in clean trusted worktrees; persistence, UI and CLI propagation were traced statically, not exercised with live accounts or a server. No PR: changing the documented public diagnostic contract is outside the simple-fix limits. Related existing issue: #4428. Public HTML includes the complete regression; raw evidence is kept outside the public repository per its AGENTS.md.
